adversarial_second_pass.independent_reconstruction: Remote measles followed years later by progressive cognitive decline, myoclonus, periodic EEG complexes and high CSF measles antibody is classic SSPE.
adversarial_second_pass.strongest_distractor_attack: JME can cause adolescent myoclonus but not progressive dementia or measles-specific CSF findings; PML, Wilson disease and anti-NMDA encephalitis have incompatible context and course.
